mechanism_prior.causal_hypothesis: Gradual diffusion of market-specific information and constrained arbitrage may cause recent relative winners among independently tradable liquid crypto assets to continue outperforming recent relative losers over a bounded holding horizon.
mechanism_prior.economic_hypothesis: A long-only top-rank portfolio, compared with a matched-capital point-in-time liquid-crypto market portfolio and cash, may improve fee- and slippage-adjusted total PnL without concentrating the result in one asset, year or terminal inventory mark.
mechanism_prior.independence_from_closed_dra_families: This is a multi-asset relative-return allocation mechanism, not another single-BTC DRA entry veto, macro state filter, on-chain admission rule or full-lot exit variant.

primary_sources.title: Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency
primary_sources.claim_boundary: The paper reports that cryptocurrency market, size and momentum factors capture cross-sectional expected returns. This supports testing a momentum mechanism but does not validate this repository's long-only implementation, venue, universe, costs or period.

primary_sources.title: Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency
primary_sources.publisher: The Review of Financial Studies / Oxford University Press
primary_sources.claim_boundary: The paper reports strong cryptocurrency time-series momentum and market-specific predictors. It is supporting context only and is not direct proof of a cross-sectional long-only portfolio.

primary_sources.title: Binance Public Data
primary_sources.claim_boundary: The official archive documents free daily and monthly spot kline files, all-symbol download helpers and per-file checksums. It does not by itself prove a historically complete point-in-time universe, delisting coverage or acceptable private-research data terms.

adversarial_sources.title: Cryptocurrency Momentum: Is It an Illusion?
adversarial_sources.publisher: International Journal of Finance and Economics / Wiley
adversarial_sources.claim_boundary: The study reports power-law risk and questions whether cryptocurrency momentum risk premia are realizable with conventional mean-variance evaluation. Any experiment therefore needs path, tail, breadth and concentration gates rather than aggregate return alone.

required_source_feasibility_proof: Enumerate a reproducible historical symbol universe from archived paths without using today's exchangeInfo as historical membership.
Demonstrate that delisted and inactive symbols are not silently omitted, or fail closed if historical membership cannot be reconstructed.
Verify archive checksums and normalize the documented post-2025 timestamp-unit change without opening post-selection outcomes.
Estimate download size and bounded local compute cost before authorizing a full corpus.
Resolve whether the archive's data-use terms permit this private research use; repository code licensing alone is not data licensing proof.
pre_outcome_design_constraints: Eligibility at each rebalance may use only bars and quote volume available before that rebalance.
Do not define the universe from current winners, current listings or hand-selected surviving assets.
Exclude stablecoin bases, wrapped duplicates and leveraged tokens using a frozen symbol taxonomy before any return outcome is computed.
Freeze one formation horizon, one holding horizon, one liquidity screen and one long-only portfolio size before performance evidence.
Use no more than three preregistered variants and compare against both cash and a matched-capital point-in-time liquid-crypto market portfolio.
Include fees, adverse slippage, turnover, realized and unrealized PnL, maximum drawdown, underwater duration, annual and asset breadth, top-asset/top-period concentration and terminal inventory.
stop_conditions: Stop with DATA_REJECT if a point-in-time universe cannot be reconstructed without survivorship or look-ahead leakage.
Stop with DATA_REJECT if checksummed free archives cannot cover a minimum preregistered Design and Validation span.
Stop before download if the bounded corpus exceeds local storage or compute limits without a smaller unbiased design.
Stop before performance if data-use permission remains materially ambiguous for the intended private research use.
After registration, stop the exact family on failed economic, drawdown, breadth, concentration or tail-risk gates; do not tune around the failure.
missing_proof: No historical corpus, checksum ledger, parent, matched comparator or deterministic runner is bound.
No Design, Validation, independent OOS or forward economics exist.
Data-use terms for the proposed archive have not been independently resolved.
scope_note: This prior performed literature and source-design analysis only. It did not download a market corpus, compute performance, register a candidate, open OOS, write canonical state, create a timer or touch Production, Trading, database, orders, funds, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE.
